fusions.name: Strip the Stalk
fusions.desc: A gnawing bite that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Chewing Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses 5 bolts of swarming insects in a spread; each deals 10 damage. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Cloud of Jaws
fusions.desc: Calls a swarm that fights for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every second. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Next Field Over
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack, 18% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
